title: Give a legacy-only named root an explicit outcome in evaluation admission and batch-gate binding, independent of Present{revision}
outcome: TermAl's decisions for a named root whose only Engram sighting is a legacy revision-only one no longer depend on whether Engram answers Present{revision} or Absent, so Engram can retire that legacy answer shape without silently changing TermAl behaviour.
acceptance: With a named root whose only sighting is legacy revision-only, evaluation admission gives coherent Present{revision} and Absent answers the same typed refusal before starting an evaluator, with a remedy to obtain a current source-identity sighting. Production batch settlement creates no verification_bind request or new credit from either answer; retained batch provenance and previously bound evidence remain readable. Behavioural tests cover both answer shapes and current-sighting and registered-verification positive controls; no test pins message text.

Code that exists only to treat Present{revision} differently from Absent in those paths is removed; the legacy answer stays parseable until Engram stops sending it. The change has a clean review pair and passes the full gate, and is landed and installed on every running TermAl host before Engram's matching retirement lands.
